content: युगम् .²1 A yoke ({%m.%} also in this sense); युगव्यायवबाहुः <ls>R. 3. 34</ls>, <ls n="R.">10. 87</ls>; <ls>Śi. 3. 68</ls>. .²2 A pair, couple, brace; कुचयोर्युगेन तरसा कलिता <ls>Śi. 9. 72</ls>; स्तनयुग <ls>Ś. 1. 19</ls>. .²3 A couple of stanzas forming one sentence; see युग्म. .²4 An age of the world; (the Yugas are four:-- कृत or सत्य, त्रेता, द्वापर and कलि; the duration of each is said to be respectively 1,728,000; 1,296,000; 864,000; and 432,000 years of men, the four together comprising 4,320,000 years of men which is equal to one Mahāyuga <ab>q. v.</ab>; it is also supposed that the regularly descending length of the Yugas represents a corresponding physical and moral deterioration in the people who live during each age, {%Krita%} being called the ‘golden’ and {%Kali%} or the present age the ‘iron’ age); धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय संभवामि युगे <ls>Bg. 4. 8</ls>; युगशतपरिवर्तान् <ls>Ś. 7. 34</ls>. .²5 (Hence) A long period of years (कालचक्र); युगं वा परिवर्तेत यद्येवं स्याद् यथाऽऽत्थ माम् <ls>Mb. 5. 160. 99</ls>. .²6 A generation, life; आ सप्तमाद् युगात् <ls>Ms. 10. 64</ls>; जात्युत्कर्षो युगे ज्ञेयः पञ्चमे सप्तमेऽपि वा <ls>Y. 1. 96</ls> (युगे = जन्मनि <ls>Mit.</ls>). .²7 An expression for the number ‘four’, rarely for ‘twelve’. .²8 A period of five years. .²9 A measure of length equal to four {%Hastas%}. .²10 A part of a chariot or plough. .²11 <ab>N.</ab> of a particular configuration of the moon.
